name: Artículos · Generador Diario (9 AM PT)
description: Generates one draft article every day at 9 AM Pacific Time (17:00 UTC, PST-anchored — drifts to 10 AM during PDT, same convention as the weekly digest). Calls /api/articles/generate on centavos.mx with the x-cron-article header and an empty body; the endpoint handles topic picking, generation via Claude Opus 4.8, and inserting the draft row into the `articles` collection. This flow is just the cron trigger + HTTP call — see lib/claude.ts + app/api/articles/generate/route.ts in centavo-nextjs for the actual work.
